focused_returned_references.summary: Represent independently varying behavior behind one caller-owned contract.
focused_returned_references.applicability: At least two credible behaviors vary independently of the caller.
focused_returned_references.preconditions: Selection owner, lifetime, fallback, and stable inputs/outputs are known.
focused_returned_references.contraindications: There is only one fixed behavior or variants do not share a coherent contract.
focused_returned_references.tradeoffs: Improves variation isolation but adds selection and lifecycle complexity.
focused_returned_references.question: Who selects the behavior?

matches: background work can outlive an active request
identity must be checked at the commit boundary
does_not_transfer: Rust serialized-owner synchronization mechanism: current HTTP handlers are threaded
manual log Stop tail policy: preview cancellation discards the result
historical_case.selected_adaptation: immutable in-process handle plus a lock around check and state publication
historical_case.limits: History was manually seeded, so this does not measure retrieval generalization or incremental value

strategy.fit: Rendering varies behind a stable job-to-result contract; caller selects a pure function
strategy.adopted: ordinary text/JSON render functions; state owner does not execute or select rendering
strategy.not_needed: strategy class hierarchy, plugin registry, automatic fallback or selection service
strategy.source_gap: Catalog source_ref is a general ATAM collection, not a direct Strategy definition; treat it as advisory routing, not authority
strategy.observed_change: JSON required only renderer and test edits; coordinator digest unchanged

agent_direct_references.fit: Associate a completion with its originating request
agent_direct_references.limit: Only the correlation idea transfers; an in-process object handle is not a serializable or authenticated message token

agent_direct_references.fit: Keep identity check and state publication in one critical section
agent_direct_references.limit: No scheduling fairness, hard thread cancellation or all-interleaving proof is claimed
